title: Add direct launcher regressions for malformed error bodies and interrupted HTTP error responses
outcome: Pin registration HTTP error diagnostics for malformed/non-JSON and oversized error bodies, plus an abort or transport loss after the status line, while preserving the HTTP phase/status, no-execution guarantee and definitive-refusal no-retry behavior.
acceptance: Real launcher/local HTTP fixture controls cover malformed or non-JSON and oversized error bodies and retain the POST/GET HTTP phase and status with bounded fallback text.
A deterministic interrupted error-body control distinguishes abort or transport loss after an HTTP status without executing a preflight/test/worker or replaying a definitive refusal.
The authorized focused launcher controls pass with actual host-recorded test evidence on the final source revision.
